summary: Align accepted OpenSpec outcomes, SemVer, distributable versions, and consumer-facing changelog prose without publishing.

outcomes: Derive release impact and consumer-facing notes from accepted OpenSpec release artifacts.

scenarios.title: Prepare a product release
scenarios.prompt: Use the maintain-release-story skill to prepare the next release from completed OpenSpec changes without publishing it.
scenarios.outcome: A verified release set aligns SemVer, manifests, components, and consumer-facing changelog entries.

scenarios.title: Audit release consistency
scenarios.prompt: Use the maintain-release-story skill to check whether package versions and release notes match the accepted product changes.
scenarios.outcome: Version or release-story drift is reported with its authoritative source and exact repair boundary.
